info.name: MOSIP eSignet (Go) — Native SSO for Mobile Apps
info.description: OpenID Connect Native SSO for Mobile Apps on eSignet (Go) + ThunderID: super app login with device_sso, child app silent sign-in by RFC 8693 token exchange, and the security/consent checks. Run top to bottom with the matching environment against a local eSignet (docker-compose + make.sh run). Keys (client assertions, DPoP Key A) are generated in pre-request scripts with WebCrypto.

item.name: 2. Child app: silent sign-in via token exchange

request.description: The child app presents the super app's id_token (subject) and device_secret (actor) with a DPoP proof signed by Key A, which the super app produced for it over IPC. The requested scope is a subset of the super app's grant and is covered by the user's consent, so no interaction is needed.
